title: Autonom Slim Profile v1
description: Which iOS Simulator background services to switch off: the settings of 'autonom simulator slim apply' as a file (profile=<path>, devices boot --slim <path>, session start --slim <path>). 'autonom simulator slim suggest' writes one for a built app; 'autonom simulator slim presets' lists the valid preset, feature and category ids. Keeping wins over disabling: need, enable and keep are subtracted from what the preset and disable switch off.

preset.description: stock disables nothing; optimized disables services an app rarely needs; minimal disables every slimmable service. Photo import, universal links and push stay on outside stock.

need.description: Feature ids the app needs (storekit, health, icloud, ...); their services stay on.

enable.description: Category ids kept on whole (search, icloud, store, ...).

disable.description: Category ids switched off in addition to the preset.

keep.description: Single launchd labels from the catalog that stay on.

names.description: A list of names, or one comma-separated string.
